post.body: Atlantic City Electric's average monthly bills, for example, will rise by $4.09 because of changes to its Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative charges, certain infrastructure investments, and shifts in transmission charges set federally. But those same bills will fall by $4.14 due to changes to some Societal Benefits Charge components and lost sales related to energy efficiency and conservation programs, leaving the average monthly bill 5 cents cheaper than before.

source.before: Some customers will see individual components of their bills increase, but those will be offset by drops to other components.
